mechanism: Betamethasone may potentiate tobramycin nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity through immunosuppression and altered renal function, while tobramycin may reduce betamethasone efficacy through induction of corticosteroid metabolism.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and auditory function closely; use lowest effective betamethasone dose; consider alternative aminoglycoside or corticosteroid if clinically feasible.
